name.en: What are Amazon UK logistics services?

spot.tr: Amazon UK lojistik ve FBA sevkiyat desteği
spot.en: Amazon UK logistics and FBA shipment support

description.tr: Han Bros Cargo, Amazon UK lojistik hizmetlerinde FBA sevkiyat hazırlığı, Amazon etiketleme standartları, depo teslimatı ve takip süreçlerini yönetir.
description.en: Han Bros Cargo manages FBA shipment preparation, Amazon labeling standards, warehouse delivery and tracking processes for Amazon UK logistics services.
